facts.value: The five option names of support_score are: all, mostly, part, little, none
facts.quote:
"all": "the quote states or directly shows every claim the value makes",
      "mostly": "the quote shows the main claim of the value; only a minor detail of the value is not in the quote",
      "part": "the quote shows some of the value, and the value also makes a real claim the quote does not show",
      "little": "the quote is on the same subject but shows little of what the value claims",
      "none": "the quote is about something else, or a number or name in the value differs from the quote"
